description: Implementation of ObliviousHttpRequest class handling encryption, decryption, serialization, and request creation for oblivious HTTP requests within the quiche project.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::Context
classes.description: Holds the HPKE context and encapsulated key for an oblivious HTTP request.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents an oblivious HTTP request with methods for creation, encryption, decryption, and serialization.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateServerObliviousRequest
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP request on the server side by decapsulating the encrypted data.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateClientObliviousRequest
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP request on the client side by encapsulating plaintext data.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateClientWithSeedForTesting
methods.description: Creates a client request with a specific seed for testing purposes.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::EncapsulateWithSeed
methods.description: Encapsulates plaintext data with optional seed, producing an encrypted request.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::EncapsulateAndSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the request into a string for transmission.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::GetPlaintextData
methods.description: Returns the plaintext data of the request.
